entry.pre_arrival: Proof of booked accommodation and a return ticket.
entry.passport_validity: Check with the Fiji High Commission; many countries ask for 6 months.
entry.other: A previous criminal record can lead to refusal. Other purposes may need a visa: ask the Fiji High Commission.

laws.rule: Jail for possession of any quantity of illegal drugs. Carry medicines in their original packaging with a copy of the prescription and a doctor's letter naming each medicine, the dose and that it is for personal use.
You can be arrested for being drunk and disorderly, including at the airport or on a plane. Police and military have detention, arrest and search powers.
Declare more than FJD 5,000 (or equivalent, any form) on arrival and more than FJD 10,000 on departure. Strict customs rules on food, weapons and sexually explicit material.
Drive on an Australian licence for the first 6 months, then a Fijian licence from the Land Transport Authority. Digital licences may not be accepted.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Conservative dress outside tourist areas; dress respectfully in villages. Same-sex relationships are legal; open affection can offend, especially in rural areas.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: The village itself: arrive through your host and ask how the village receives visitors before you go.
culture-and-protocol.note: Read from the Australian Government's description of local customs. Village protocol in Fiji's own terms is still to be recorded.

meetings.route: Business visitor permit (21 days, not extendable)
meetings.detail: Business visits by visa-exempt nationals use a business visitor permit; longer work needs a work permit.
meetings.next: Carry an invitation and proof of funds; confirm the permit at the border or with the Ministry.

conference.route: Business visitor permit (21 days, not extendable)
conference.detail: Attending as a delegate fits a business visit.

unpaid-speaking.route: Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit (up to 12 weeks)
unpaid-speaking.detail: Covers business, research, religious activities or consultancy on a visitor permit, with a letter of request and undertaking from the host organisation.
unpaid-speaking.next: Ask the host to apply to the Ministry before you travel.

paid-speaking.route: Short Term Work Permit (or the Authority to Work for consultancy)
paid-speaking.detail: Paid work beyond a business visit needs a Short Term Work Permit; the business visitor permit is 21 days and not for paid work.
paid-speaking.next: Ask the host to apply before travel.

book-launch.route: Business visitor permit if unpaid; Short Term Work Permit (or the Authority to Work for consultancy) if paid
book-launch.detail: An unpaid talk fits a business visit; paid appearances need a permit.
book-launch.next: Keep it unpaid, or ask the host to apply.

ai-teaching.route: Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit (up to 12 weeks)
ai-teaching.detail: Consultancy and research are named activities under the authority.
ai-teaching.next: Host organisation's letter and application before travel.

remote-work.detail: No remote-work rule was found on the Ministry's pages.

entrepreneur.route: Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit (up to 12 weeks)
entrepreneur.detail: Business or investment activity is a named purpose; operating a business needs Investment Fiji registration.

trade.route: Business visitor permit (21 days, not extendable) or Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit (up to 12 weeks)
trade.detail: Meetings and negotiation are business visits; delivery is work.
trade.next: Separate the meeting trip from any delivery work.

artist.route: Short Term Work Permit (or the Authority to Work for consultancy)
artist.detail: Paid performance isn't allowed on a visitor permit.
artist.next: Ask the promoter to apply before travel.

mixed-mission.route: Visitor or business visitor permit, plus a work permit for any paid part
mixed-mission.detail: Visitor routes don't cover paid work.

filming.route: Fiji Film Permit from Film Fiji, plus the right immigration authority for crew
filming.detail: Visiting productions need a single Fiji Film Permit for the whole shoot, with cast and crew passports, flights and an equipment list. Public spaces need about 7 days' notice, national parks about 14.
filming.next: Apply to Film Fiji well ahead; ask whether crew enter on the business visitor permit or a work permit.

research.route: Authority to Work or Study while on a Visitors Permit (up to 12 weeks)
research.detail: Research is a named purpose under the authority.
research.next: Host institution's letter; some research needs its own permits.

volunteering.route: Work permit under the volunteer category
volunteering.detail: Fiji's Ministry of Immigration lists a volunteer work permit among its work permits; visitor permits don't cover volunteer work.
volunteering.next: Ask the host organisation to apply before travel.

items.text: When visiting a village, it's customary to present a small bundle or packet of powdered kava (a sevusevu) to the village chief, to ask permission to enter as a guest. The sevusevu ceremony has its own seating etiquette; follow your guide.
Kava (also known as ‘yaqona’), a traditional Pacific region drink, can be a health risk.
It can be dangerous if it reacts with alcohol, prescription medication, including antidepressants.
You can go to jail for possession of any quantity of illegal drugs.
This includes if you are: carrying or using drugs partying safely with drugs
You can be arrested for being drunk and disorderly, including while you’re at an airport or on a plane.
